description:
Find products Amazon considers similar to a given ASIN: returns the source product plus a 'similar' list of related ASINs with title, brand, category and image. This is the competitor and alternative discovery tool.

Use this tool when the user asks for alternatives, competing products, or 'what else is like this?' for a specific ASIN. For keyword-based discovery without a starting product, use search_products instead. To compare the found products in depth, follow up with get_product_detail on the ASINs that matter.

Cost depends on similar_limit: 10 results = 1 credit (default), 50 = 6 credits, 100 = 11 credits. If no similar products are found, only 1 credit is charged. Keep the default 10 unless the user asks for a broad list. Delivery-address localization is not supported for this operation.

asin.description: Amazon Standard Identification Number, a 10-character alphanumeric product identifier (e.g. B0CJB6V2L5). Found in the product URL after /dp/ or /gp/product/.

domain.description: Amazon marketplace domain extension. Determines the regional Amazon site the data is fetched from. Use the domain that matches the user's market, because prices, availability and rankings differ across marketplaces.

similar_limit.description: Maximum number of similar products to return: '10' (1 credit, default), '50' (6 credits) or '100' (11 credits).

name: get_similar_products

credits_remaining.description: Credits left on the account after this request.

data.description: Parsed Amazon data for the operation.

operation.description: Easyparser operation that ran, e.g. DETAIL or OFFER.

request_id.description: Easyparser request ID, useful for support and error logs.
